run.executedVia: Playwright (automated); every assertion cross-checked against the ServiceNow Table API

case.title: The orphan request never appears in the portal grid

steps.text: Confirm the orphan exists and is genuinely unlinked.
Count all requests, and those that would qualify for the grid.

observations: A tester who counts rows will find more records in the table than in the grid. This is expected behaviour, documented here so it is not raised as a defect.
Not to be confused with the TASK CAFT0001001, which is a live attestation task on RCAF0001022.
expected: RCAF0001001 has no business application and no control, so getRequests() filters it out of the grid.
It remains present in the caf_req table — filtered from a view, not deleted.
actual: 132 requests in the table, 131 linked to a business application.
case.verdictReason: Orphan present in the table, correctly excluded from the grid.
